name: wafermap-framework-stub
description: Type-level test harness and gate commands for the SubstrateMap TwinCAT HMI controls (Framework 14.4.5 d.ts subset, tsc 5.9.2). NOT shipped with the control; it is what runs the tests and the checkers.

scripts.check: node tools/check-spelling.mjs && node tools/check-templates.mjs && node tools/check-descriptors.mjs && node tools/check-manifest.mjs && node tools/check-readme.mjs && node tools/check-hmiextproj.mjs && node tools/check-schema-cardinality.mjs && node tools/check-state.mjs
scripts.check:strict: node tools/check-spelling.mjs && node tools/check-templates.mjs --strict && node tools/check-descriptors.mjs --strict && node tools/check-manifest.mjs --strict && node tools/check-readme.mjs --strict && node tools/check-hmiextproj.mjs --strict && node tools/check-schema-cardinality.mjs --strict && node tools/check-state.mjs --strict
scripts.gate: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Helpers/SubstrateMapEngine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Controls/SubstrateMapBase/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Controls/SubstrateMap/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Controls/SubstrateMapFilterBar/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Controls/SubstrateMapWidget/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p Controls/SubstrateMapBinChart/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run coverage:strict && npm run check:strict
